entities.summary: Marufatu Abiola Bawuah is a Ghanaian financial executive and businesswoman. In 2014, she became the managing director/chief executive officer of United Bank for Africa, making her the first woman to hold that position. She has won several awards for her work which includes the 2016 Chartered Institute of Marketing Ghana Marketing Woman of the Year and the Finance Personality of the Year Award at the Ghana Accountancy and Finance.
